title: grafana-schema: CUE-generated TS schema pipeline (entry points & flow)
answers: How does CUE generation flow into packages/grafana-schema?
What is src/veneer/ for in grafana-schema?
Where are composable panel option types generated?
body:
packages/grafana-schema/src is a generation *target*, not hand-written source (files have 'EDITING IS FUTILE' headers). Three families:
- Core/common schemas: `kinds/gen.go` walks `kinds/<x>/*.cue`, runs jennies incl. `pkg/codegen/jenny_tsveneerindex.go:TSVeneerIndexJenny`, writes `src/raw/dashboard/x/types.gen.ts` + `src/index.gen.ts`. Separately `public/app/plugins/gen.go:genCommon` reads `src/common/*.cue` directly (these .cue files ARE canonical; the comment in `src/common/dataquery_gen.cue` claiming a `pkg/kindsys/dataquery.cue` origin is stale/wrong) and regenerates `src/common/common.gen.ts` via `cuetsy.Generate`.
- Composable (per-plugin) kinds: each plugin's `public/app/plugins/panel/<name>/panelcfg.cue` imports `ui "github.com/grafana/grafana/packages/grafana-schema/src/common"`; `public/app/plugins/gen.go` emits output to BOTH the plugin-local `panelcfg.gen.ts` AND the mirrored `packages/grafana-schema/src/raw/composable/<name>/panelcfg/x/types.gen.ts`.
- App-SDK resource schemas: `src/schema/dashboard/v2beta1/` etc., versioned dirs (v0alpha1, v1beta1, v2, v2alpha1, v2beta1), exposed via `package.json` exports map subpaths like `./apis/dashboard.grafana.app/*`.
Public entry is `src/index.ts`, which re-exports `veneer/common.types`, `veneer/librarypanel.types`, `index.gen.ts`, plus one manual enum override (`LegendDisplayMode`) kept because CUE can't deprecate individual enum members. Regenerate everything with `make gen-cue` from repo root; CI checks drift via `CODEGEN_VERIFY` env var (see `public/app/plugins/gen.go` around `genCommon` call).
